title: Los Angeles
summary: Los Angeles was founded on 4 September 1781 by 44 settlers of Native American, African and European heritage who travelled from present-day northern Mexico to the site of the Gabrieleno village of Yangna. It had only 315 residents in 1800 but grew under Spanish, Mexican and US rule into one of the largest metropolitan cities in the world.
